hypothesis: Cold COPEN request ownership differs from a Copper already waiting; explicit COPJMP can be isolated after warming the request gate.
competitor: The immediate post-write error also occurs with a warm sleeping Copper, indicating a strobe/read or bitplane interaction rather than initial COPEN.
test: 96 ROM-only cases: COPEN off/cold/warm crossed with COPJMP/inert write, four launch phases and four repeats. Warm Copper enabled at line40 and waits until43:40. Measured input atline42; finite completion and negative witnesses. Two independent A500 runs.

outcomes.warm inert matches but cold inert differ: Isolate initial COPEN request sampling; keep explicit restart separate.
outcomes.warm COPJMP differs: Constrain explicit restart bus ownership independently of cold enable.
outcomes.warm inert also differs: Revisit common bitplane/read path before modifying Init.
